مُصْحِبٌ [properly Having a companion. ―
-b2- And hence,] A man having a son that has attained to manhood, and become like him. (K, * TA.) ―
-b3- And (tropical:) One who talks to himself; and so, sometimes, ↓ مُصْحَبٌ . (K, TA.) ―
-b4- And (tropical:) Tractable, submissive, or obsequious, after being refractory, or incompliant; (K;) as also ↓ مُصَاحِبٌ , (A, K,) and ↓ مُسْتَصْحِبٌ . (TA. [See also the next paragraph.]) ―
-b5- And (assumed tropical:) Going straight on, or right on, without delay. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
